mapper.select: select count(distinct T1.course_id) as finish_course_count, count(if(T2.type = #{theory_type}, TRUE, NULL )) as finish_theory_count, count(if(T2.type = #{exp_type}, TRUE, NULL )) as finish_exp_count from oj_lesson_record T1 left join oj_course_lesson T2 on T1.lesson_id = T2.resource_id where T1.user_id = #{user_id} and T1.lesson_id in (select resource_id from oj_course_lesson);

select count(T1.resource_id) as course_count, count(if(T2.type = #{theory_type}, TRUE, NULL )) as theory_count, count(if(T2.type = #{exp_type}, TRUE, NULL )) as exp_count from oj_course T1 left join oj_course_lesson T2 on T1.resource_id = T2.course_id;

select count(T1.resource_id) as practice_count, count(if(T3.id, TRUE ,NULL )) as finish_practice_count from oj_paper T1 left join oj_course_lesson T2 on T1.resource_id = T2.paper_id left join oj_lesson_paper_evaluate T3 on T2.resource_id = T3.lesson_id where T3.submit_user_id = #{user_id} and T1.type = #{paper_type} and T1.resource_id in (select paper_id from oj_course_lesson);

select T1.resource_id, T1.name, R1.name as direction_name, T1.difficulty, count(T2.id) as lesson_count, count(if(T2.type = #{theory_type}, TRUE, NULL)) as learned_theory, count(if(T2.type = #{exp_type}, TRUE, NULL)) as learned_exp, count(T3.id) as learned_exp_report, count(T4.id) as learned_after_class_practice from oj_course T1 left join oj_course_category R1 on T1.category_id = R1.resource_id left join oj_course_lesson T2 on T1.resource_id = T2.course_id left join oj_note T3 on T2.resource_id = T3.business_id and T3.note_type = #{report_code} left join oj_lesson_paper_evaluate T4 on T2.resource_id = T4.lesson_id and T4.submit_user_id = #{user_id} where T2.resource_id in (select lesson_id from oj_lesson_record where user_id = #{user_id}) group by T1.name;
